question: A regular hexagonal mirror has a side of 18 cm. If 12% of the mirror area is covered by the frame, what is the visible glass area?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Area of a regular hexagon = 6 × (√3 ÷ 4) × (side)²

Total Area = 6 × (√3 ÷ 4) × 18² = 486√3 cm² ≈ 486 × 1.732 = 841.75 cm².

Since 12% is covered by the frame, visible glass area is 100% − 12% = 88% of the total area.

Visible Area = 0.88 × 841.75 = 740.74 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 740.7 cm².**
